metas.name: 1. Elementary School Musical
metas.description: Marge sends Lisa to a performing arts camp, where counselors and fellow campers inspire her to embrace her creative side; upon returning to Springfield, Lisa grows restless with her boring suburban lifestyle.

metas.name: 2. Loan-a-Lisa
metas.description: Grampa gives each family member a portion of his savings; Lisa worries that Nelson's instant success with a new business venture might lure him away from continuing his education.

metas.name: 3. MoneyBART
metas.description: Lisa starts coaching Bart's Little League team; Marge and Bart spend the day at an amusement park, where former MLB manager Mike Scioscia gives Bart advice.

metas.name: 4. Treehouse of Horror XXI
metas.description: Worried about the effects of violent video games, Marge encourages Bart and Milhouse to play board games; Lisa becomes smitten with a new student, a vampire; while on a second honeymoon, Homer and Marge rescue a castaway who escaped from his ship.

metas.name: 5. Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
metas.description: Fearing that she will end up like Marge, Lisa pledges to focus solely on her academics and not get distracted by other things; Bart puts Nelson in his place and unintentionally earns the title of school bully.

metas.name: 6. The Fool Monty
metas.description: Mr. Burns becomes distraught at the town's apathetic reaction to the announcement that he has only weeks to live; Bart secretly takes Burns into the family's home.

metas.name: 7. How Munched Is That Birdie in the Window?
metas.description: After Bart nurses an injured bird back to health, Homer enters it in a race.

metas.name: 8. The Fight Before Christmas
metas.description: When the rest of the family seems to lack Christmas spirit, Marge contacts Martha Clause.

metas.name: 9. Donnie Fatso
metas.description: Homer ends up in the Springfield penitentiary after getting caught bribing an official; an FBI investigator offers Homer a way to reduce his jail time.

metas.name: 10. Moms I'd Like to Forget
metas.description: Marge reconnects with a close group of mothers she used to be friends with; Bart tries to break up their group when his playdates stop being fun.

metas.name: 11. Flaming Moe
metas.description: When Smithers transforms Moe's pub into a refined and trendy lounge, the establishment becomes Springfield's local gay hangout; Principal Skinner falls for the new, free-spirited music teacher.

metas.name: 12. Homer the Father
metas.description: When Homer insists Bart must earn the new dirt bike he wants, Bart comes up with a scheme; James Lipton interviews a TV cast.

metas.name: 13. The Blue and the Gray
metas.description: Moe attends a seminar in hope of gaining more confidence with women; Marge makes a change after discovering her gray hair.

metas.name: 14. Angry Dad: The Movie
metas.description: Bart's film about an angry father quickly becomes a critical favorite, winning him several awards.

metas.name: 15. The Scorpion's Tale
metas.description: During a field trip, Lisa discovers desert water that makes usually combative creatures get along; after getting kicked out of the retirement home, Grampa comes to live with the family.

metas.name: 16. A Midsummer's Nice Dream
metas.description: When Cheech and Chong stop in Springfield while on their reunion tour, Homer impresses Cheech so much he asks him to replace Chong; Principal Skinner forms a new comedy team with Chong; Marge tries to help a hoarder.

metas.name: 17. Love Is a Many Strangled Thing
metas.description: Marge persuades Homer to enroll in a fathering enrichment class; Bart becomes a school bully.

metas.name: 18. The Great Simpsina
metas.description: When the Great Raymondo takes Lisa on as his magician's assistant, she is conned into revealing the secret of his greatest trick to his nemesis.

metas.name: 19. The Real Housewives of Fat Tony
metas.description: Fat Tony and Marge's sister, Selma, fall in love and get married; Bart discovers a special ability.

metas.name: 20. Homer Scissorhands
metas.description: Homer opens his own hair salon after discovering he is a talented stylist; Milhouse professes his love for Lisa.

metas.name: 21. 500 Keys
metas.description: After finding the keys to every door in Springfield, Lisa finds a hidden room beneath the elementary school.

metas.name: 22. The Ned-liest Catch
metas.description: When Ned starts dating Mrs. Krabappel, he is surprised to learn how many of Springfield's men she has been with.
